name: extension_cost_of_non_adoption
description: What an implementation forgoes by not declaring a live extension: the concrete cost of skipping it.

aiGuidance.purpose: The concrete cost of not adopting this extension, for a live extension.
aiGuidance.extraction: State plainly what an implementation gives up or must otherwise handle itself by not declaring the extension. Continuous prose, no headings. Restate what is already normative elsewhere in the specification; do not introduce a new claim here. Empty on a dormant record.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: Do not use this field to state new normative rules — it summarises what the extension's own normative surface already establishes.
